newsitem.title: USA: NYS panel approves $710 mln of funding, bond sales.
newsitem.headline: NYS panel approves $710 mln of funding, bond sales.

text.p: The New York State Public Authorities Control Board at a regular meeting here approved on Tuesday about $710 million of funding and bond sales for various state authority projects.
The Dormitory Authority had the most funds and bonds approved, totaling $528.09 million.

Among the Dormitory Authority projects approved were $94 million for the tax-exempt equipment leasing program, $295 million for a FHA-insured mortgage loan for the Medical Care Facilities Finance Agency 1989 Series A bonds bond refinancing and financing various projects at Montefiore Hospital in Bronx County, N.Y., $29 million refunding and new money for Barnard College, and $44.9 million for Ithaca College for refunding and new money.
The control board also approved $150.5 million of bonds for the State of New York Mortgage Finance Agency for proposed long-term issues.

The Housing Finance Agency was authorized to spend $20.8 million, including $18.1 million of bonds, for the financing of a 240-unit multi-family housing project, Landings at Halfmoon, in Halfmoon, N.Y.
The Urban Development Corp was given approval to fund various projects, including $300,000 for the Moriah/Essex County Incubator Economic Development Project.
And the Environmental Facilities Corporation was given permission to fund a Village of Waterville project with $847,000.

However, a $72 million project, with $65 million of bonds, for the Riverbank State Park special obligation refunding revenue bonds, 1996 Series to refund $56.9 million of principal amount of EFC State Park Special Obligation revenue bonds, Series 1992, was deferred so that the state Assembly could study the project.
A special meeting will be called before the regular December 18 Public Authorities Control Board meeting to determine the fate of the project and its financing.
